title: Approximate tangent space forces density θ(x) (Simon 3.1.8(2))
statement: Let n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, V = v(M, θ) a rectifiable n-varifold in U, x ∈ U, and P a subspace which is the approximate tangent space of M at x with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P). Then Θⁿ(μ_V, x) = θ(x), i.e. V.HasDensity x (θ x).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ U → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P → V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)
